title: US Flew Surveillance Drone Over Mexico to Help Capture Top Drug Lord
detail: France 24 reports that the US flew a surveillance drone over Mexico to help capture a top drug lord. Only the headline was available at time of writing; the individual and organization involved are not confirmed here.

title: Mexico to Try 'El Chapo Isidro' Despite US Extradition Request
detail: Al Jazeera reports that Mexico intends to try 'El Chapo Isidro' domestically despite a US extradition request. Only the headline was available at time of writing; further details are not confirmed here.
